title: Lazy Sunday Middle Eastern Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, this hearty tagine is perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of Middle Eastern Olive Oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped Garlicky Eastern Onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cubed Meat Substitute and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped Rest of the World Carrots and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Eastern Canned Diced Tomatoes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Lazy Sunday Tagine Spice Mix and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
